body:
For repositories it is important to show how much lines in the repository for each language.

Also it is important to show how much lines of code I have written in open-source myself in each language, and in total, as open-source lines of code, including based on my contributions to not owned projects.

We should not include data from private repositories and explicitly write, that this is only data based on open-source, so closed source experience contains much more based on positions from CV.

We should also show the same iconic GitHub contributions matrix on the website, with slogan `Discipline comes first in any work or art`, and explanation under. My goal was to do at least 1 contribution per day, until it became my habit which grown to current state. Iconic GitHub contributions matrix should look the same as on GitHub, so it should use all the same data, including private repositories.

That text should be conditional, as if I drop out of discipline it does not matter anymore. So that should be shown only when I alive or actively working.

Ideally we should update all data live, but if it is impossible we should write effective data for all the numbers using (*), which explained in the page footer.

We need also to update all our dependencies, use all the latest of associative stack where applicable, and make sure all data on the website is fully updated.

And we should prefer embedded messages from social networks over fallback to historical extract.

Also check our organizations and personal repositories, and we have something missing in https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/blob/main/docs/associative-tech-stack.md we should report issue to Formal AI.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: We need to better present our key indicators
